description: Less is a way to write CSS with shared names, small recipes and calculations. A tool turns it into normal CSS. Learn by styling small boxes and checking the CSS that the tool makes. Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
versionNote: Uses Less 4 syntax and the lessc command-line compiler.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change ink to teal and build the file again
Learn to use soft-box in a third rule called message
Learn to call the mixin with 16px and check what is output
learningObjectives: Learn to change ink to teal and build the file again
